test_title: PYST 43: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under its original jurisdiction, the Supreme Court of India can adjudicate disputes between:

options.text: The Centre and one or more states
Two private citizens from different states
Two municipal corporations of different states
A state government and a private corporation

solution:
The Correct answer is __**The Centre and one or more states**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **original jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court of India is defined under **Article 131** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• In its original jurisdiction, the Supreme Court can adjudicate disputes between the **Government of India (Centre) and one or more states**.
 
• This jurisdiction is exclusive to the Supreme Court, meaning no other court in India can handle such disputes.
 
• It also includes disputes between **two or more states**, or between the Centre and any state(s) on one side and other states on the other side.
 
• This ensures the maintenance of a **federal balance** and resolves any legal conflicts that may arise between different levels of government.
 
• However, it is important to note that this jurisdiction is limited to **questions of law** or **questions of fact** on which the existence of a legal right depends.
 
• Some examples of cases under this jurisdiction include disputes related to **taxation, water disputes, or constitutional interpretation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Two private citizens from different states**__

 __
 
• Disputes between private citizens are not within the **original jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court.
 
• Such matters are generally dealt with by **civil courts** or **high courts** in India.
 
 
 
• **Two municipal corporations of different states**__
 __
 
• Municipal corporations are governed by their respective state governments, and any disputes between them would not fall under the **original jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court.
 
• Such cases would typically be resolved within the jurisdiction of the respective **state high courts**.
 
 
 
• **A state government and a private corporation**__
 
 
• Disputes involving private corporations are not covered under Article 131.
 
• Such matters are generally resolved through **civil courts** or other legal mechanisms, including tribunals.
